scoreboard._which_scoreboard: THE LAB SHOULD MOVE. THE POOL SHOULD SIT STILL. My own pool arithmetic, derived before the run from data/team-pool-frozen/games.bo3.jsonl (13,214 games), requiring the STONE to be paired with its base for the four mega crossers: victreebel+victreebelite 29 games (11 also carry a weight move), feraligatr+feraligite 54 (20), skarmory+skarmorite 55 (10), barbaracite+barbaracle 19 (10), gourgeist-small 7 (4), gourgeist-super 13 (5). UNION = 60 of 13,214 = 4.36 expected games in a 961 sample. That is OPPORTUNITY only: the weight move must also be CLICKED, aimed at that body, while it stands in the crossing forme, inside the 12-turn cap. At a generous 15% that is ~0.65 expected board-material games.
